$doc: Action context (designed 2026-10-05): actions found inside the batch before Review, from every line of the original plus the source's new wiki page; each item points at the original's lines (.raw/captured/) and the wiki section; the To confirm preview shows what Create draft will write. Spec: docs/specs/action-context.md.

layouts.pane: {detail}

states.label: A · To confirm: the full title and where it goes; open it to see the original’s lines, the wiki, the fields and what Create draft will write
B · Item detail: FROM shows the original’s lines and the wiki section, each with Open
C · Review: looking for actions while you read the change (Approve doesn’t wait)
D · Review: actions found, every line looked through; a source left out dims its actions
Slack message preview
states.caption: Nothing is sent: Copy, then Mark as sent, as today.

states.label: To-do preview
states.caption: Add puts it in To do as it is; to-dos get no AI draft.

states.label: From Ask: closest lines in the original
states.caption: The answer comes from the wiki; Distill follows the cited page to its archived original and shows the lines that share the most words, labelled as closest, never as a quote.

states.label: From Ask: wiki only
states.caption: No archived original (or no lines share 40% of the words): the item says so and drafts from the wiki section.

states.label: Review: part of a source couldn’t be looked through
states.caption: Named with its lines and Try again; never dropped silently.

states.label: How a long source is covered
states.caption: A 130 KB transcript is 2 windows; the core records each window’s lines.

states.label: Re-reads and repair
states.caption: Matched by the original’s content hash, so a repair from .raw/captured/ adds nothing twice.

states.label: What each item keeps
states.caption: Additive fields on the item’s source; older items keep working.

boards.title: Action context · actions from the original + the wiki
boards.heading: Actions come from the original and the wiki, and you see what they’ll write
boards.intro: “A lot of the detail is removed after it’s added to the wiki, so the item becomes hard to understand.” Actions are now found inside the batch, before Review: Distill sends every line of each original (in windows, so a 130 KB meeting is read to its end) together with the source’s new wiki page. Each item points at the exact lines of the original, archived in .raw/captured/, and at the wiki section it relates to. Drafts are written from those lines and that section, never from the first 12,000 characters of a note. Found items wait in the batch and enter Actions when their source’s pages apply; nothing outside Distill happens before you approve, and Jira and Confluence are still created only on your click.

sections.title: To confirm: know what it will create before Create draft
In Review: found while the batch is read, information only
